changelog: Lose or win, the run-end screen now shows where you fell — act, step and node — plus your kills, deaths, steps and buildings built behind the score, and it's the same summary whether you win, lose, or retreat. Objective battles now explain themselves up front: Hold the Position and Survive get a proper briefing instead of just naming the enemy, and a dug-in Garrison no longer shows up as the foe on a hold mission. Tell a unit to Hold and it now braces, converting your unspent Command Points into cover (+defense). Non-combatants like the Bannerman rank up for toughness only — they no longer wrongly gain attack. Med Pack is now a free crate-only one-shot, your units show rank and XP even before their first promotion, Recon scouts a little closer in (1–2 tiles), the medal row is now transparent over the board, and achievement popups linger a bit longer.
